description: This source file defines the ApplicationsStackLayout class, a custom ViewGroup layout used in Android to layout and display application icons in a stacked form for a home screen, supporting vertical and horizontal orientations, managing recents and favorites icons, and drawing backgrounds.

classes.name: ApplicationsStackLayout
classes.description: A custom layout for stacking application icons in a home screen, supporting vertical and horizontal orientations, handling recents and favorites sections, and drawing background elements.

methods.name: ApplicationsStackLayout
methods.description: Constructor initializing the layout with context-specific or attribute-based settings.

methods.name: getOrientation
methods.description: Returns the current orientation (horizontal or vertical) of the layout.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles custom drawing of background regions behind recents and favorites sections.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the layout's dimensions, enforcing exact measure specs.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions the layout's child views, including the button, recents, and favorites, based on orientation.

methods.name: layoutVertical
methods.description: Arranges child views in a vertical stack from bottom up.

methods.name: layoutHorizontal
methods.description: Arranges child views in a horizontal sequence from right to left.

methods.name: stackApplications
methods.description: Creates and positions application icons in the specified list, stacking them in vertical or horizontal manner.

methods.name: removeAllApplications
methods.description: Removes all application icon views from the layout, except the button.

methods.name: createApplicationIcon
methods.description: Inflates and configures a TextView to represent an application icon with icon and title.

methods.name: setFavorites
methods.description: Sets the list of favorite applications and requests layout update.

methods.name: setRecents
methods.description: Sets the list of recent applications and requests layout update.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on application icons by launching their intents.
